title: Setting Room Nine  (Preparando o Quarto Nove)

segments.t: Às duas e meia — trinta minutos antes da visita do patrimônio da cidade — Hannah, Evelyn e Graham dão os últimos retoques nas mesas ensolaradas dentro do Quarto Nove. Ouça primeiro.
Four white linen cloths ironed flat, three folding chairs around each table.
Look how pretty a single green leaf looks in each small glass vase, Hannah.
I hung the wooden welcome sign outside the street gate ten minutes ago.
Did anyone stop to read it on Linden Street, Graham?
Three neighbours read every word and asked when the tea kettle boils!
Listen while I play the transition into bar twenty-eight on the piano...
Every single note rings warm and clear—especially middle D!
Leave the two arched courtyard windows open so the music carries outside.
Look at my sheet music stand: Arthur's aunt's black ink on page one, mine on page two.
Thirty years apart, one continuous waltz.
Quarter to three on my watch. Where is Arthur?
Practising his welcome speech in the mirror—let us go rescue him!
Agora vamos revisar linha por linha com a tradução em português.
Four white linen cloths ironed flat, three folding chairs around each table.
'Quatro toalhas de linho branco passadas bem lisinhas, três cadeiras dobráveis em volta de cada mesa.'
Look how pretty a single green leaf looks in each small glass vase, Hannah.
'Veja como fica bonita uma única folha verde em cada pequeno vaso de vidro, Hannah.'
I hung the wooden welcome sign outside the street gate ten minutes ago.
'Pendurei a placa de madeira de boas-vindas do lado de fora do portão da rua há dez minutos.'
Did anyone stop to read it on Linden Street, Graham?
'Alguém parou para lê-la na Linden Street, Graham?'
Three neighbours read every word and asked when the tea kettle boils!
'Três vizinhos leram cada palavra e perguntaram quando a chaleira do chá ferve!'
Listen while I play the transition into bar twenty-eight on the piano...
'Ouçam enquanto eu toco a transição para o compasso vinte e oito no piano...'
Every single note rings warm and clear—especially middle D!
'Cada nota soa calorosa e nítida — especialmente o ré central!'
Leave the two arched courtyard windows open so the music carries outside.
'Deixem as duas janelas em arco do pátio abertas para que a música chegue lá fora.'
Look at my sheet music stand: Arthur's aunt's black ink on page one, mine on page two.
'Olhem para a minha estante de partitura: a tinta preta da tia do Arthur na página um, a minha na página dois.'
Thirty years apart, one continuous waltz.
'Trinta anos de distância, uma única valsa contínua.'
Quarter to three on my watch. Where is Arthur?
'Quinze para as três no meu relógio. Onde está o Arthur?'
Practising his welcome speech in the mirror—let us go rescue him!
'Ensaiando o discurso de boas-vindas dele no espelho — vamos lá resgatá-lo!'
Agora vamos ouvir a conversa inteira uma última vez.
Four white linen cloths ironed flat, three folding chairs around each table.
Look how pretty a single green leaf looks in each small glass vase, Hannah.
I hung the wooden welcome sign outside the street gate ten minutes ago.
Did anyone stop to read it on Linden Street, Graham?
Three neighbours read every word and asked when the tea kettle boils!
Listen while I play the transition into bar twenty-eight on the piano...
Every single note rings warm and clear—especially middle D!
Leave the two arched courtyard windows open so the music carries outside.
Look at my sheet music stand: Arthur's aunt's black ink on page one, mine on page two.
Thirty years apart, one continuous waltz.
Quarter to three on my watch. Where is Arthur?
Practising his welcome speech in the mirror—let us go rescue him!
O Quarto Nove brilha ao sol da tarde, os vizinhos já estão curiosos no portão e faltam apenas quinze minutos para as três horas. Até a próxima.
See you next time.
